name: 43302 · Marion, OH
findings: ZIP 43302 (Marion) has 207 nonprofit organizations. 81 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43302 (Marion) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
